name: Waffles
dish: Same-day waffles, thin crisp shell and soft moist middle thanks to cornstarch in batter; served hot with butter and maple syrup. Serves 4.

stages.do: add wet items, sugar, vanilla; stir
ingredients: Whole milk or buttermilk (or a combination)

stages.do: preheat iron; cook per maker instructions
serve at once with toppings, OR keep warm in low oven: single layer straight on oven rack, never stacked (stacking = soggy)
ingredients: Butter and pure maple syrup, for serving

notes: Leftovers re-crisp well in a toaster. No overnight rise needed. Toppings unmeasured.
